name: West Florida Components
old_description: Electronic components and parts supplier: semiconductors, capacitors, diodes, transistors, resistors, rubber feet, project boxes & more...since 2005, West Florida Components is your online source for electronic parts and supplies for your electronics projects.
about:
Founded in 2005 in Tarpon Springs, Florida, West Florida Components operates as an online distributor of electronic components. The company is now part of Supply Shield, with its warehouse located in St. Petersburg, Florida, and is not open to the public.

The company stocks a wide range of electronic components across categories including semiconductors, capacitors, diodes, transistors, resistors, enclosures, and hardware. It emphasizes an in-stock guarantee—only advertising parts physically present in its warehouse—and offers same-day shipping for orders paid by 1 PM. The catalog also includes vintage parts and clearance items.

West Florida Components serves hobbyists, educators, and professionals seeking electronic components for projects, prototyping, and repair, with a focus on obsolete and hard-to-find parts. Its online catalog includes learning resources such as component glossaries, datasheets, and project guides, supporting both novice and experienced builders.

The company differentiates itself by specializing in obsolete and hard-to-find electronic parts, maintaining a strict in-stock policy, and providing toll-free customer support. During its transition to Supply Shield, it requires a minimum order of $150 and directs customers to phone-based ordering.
